concepts.gloss_en: Business dealings / commerce as such (the general activity), identified with the union of tzaddik and Knesset Yisrael

members.note: representative; the bare activity of commerce

concepts.gloss_en: Business dealings conducted in faith/honesty — a qualified mode of commerce that fulfills 've'ahavta'; distinct from bare משא ומתן by the qualifier באמונה

members.note: representative; qualified activity, not bare commerce (rule 4: state-about-X ≠ X)

concepts.gloss_en: The one who conducts business in faith — the agent/doer, not the activity itself

members.note: the doer (person) is a different concept than the act (rule 4); construct head is 'the one who does'

notes: Three distinct heads: the bare activity (משא ומתן), the faith-qualified activity (משא ומתן באמונה), and the agent who performs it (העושה...). All co-occur in lm1:93 but name different things; kept separate per under-merge and rule 4.
